payload.application_scope: Ledger item 2 only: the pro-two specialization as a factor list and the tame specialization as a record field. No coefficient module, marking, field, resolver, eta or source certificate is selected.
payload.gate: Gate C removes the tau letter and collapses every omega2 power. It does NOT collapse the profinite eta-hat power or the integer two-power conjugator at Npc, and the Npc correction block stays folded in the tree's own statement because what matters about it is its value, not its pro-two syntax.
payload.hash_scope: Identity of the serialized factor list, its descriptions and the two bindings at the stated discrete parameters. It is not a hash of any PWord value.

factors.description: x0 to the power two plus two to the alpha
the commutator of x0 with the profinite eta-hat power of sigma, which Gate C keeps
the inverse conjugate of x2 by x1 times the integer two-power conjugator, which Gate C keeps
x2 times the unit that is the collapsed tau
the correction block, left folded in the tree's own statement as the pro-two image of eBlockW

pro_two.tail: the handle tail is EMPTY at this rank, which is the certificate's own convention and not a simplification (the handles block handlesW, pro-two invariant by GQ2.Dyadic.Words.pro2_handlesW)

payload.warning: The two halves of item 2 are NOT in the same state and are not presented as if they were. The pro-two half is a syntactic identity between PWord values, restated here and discharged by the tree's own theorem, so a wrong factor list does not compile; the factor descriptions themselves are prose. The tame half is a Prop carried as a record field, and proof irrelevance makes its binding a statement identity, not proof identity. Separately: item 2 is also where the three field-selection adapters are pinned, and those are NOT standard-three, each carrying four documented standing arithmetic and reciprocity inputs. Nothing in this artifact touches them or weakens that class.
